desc:
• QUALITY INGREDIENTS: Crunchy bars are made with whole grain oats and cinnamon

  • WHOLESOME SNACK BAR: Tasty snack with no artificial flavors, no artificial colors, and no artificial sweeteners

  • WHOLE GRAIN: 22g of whole grain per serving (at least 48g recommended daily)

  • PERFECTLY PORTABLE: Easy bites for breakfast time or snack time; A crunchy, sweet taste you can take anywhere

  • CONTAINS: One 8.94 oz box of Nature Valley Cinnamon Crunchy Granola Bars; 6 two-bar pouches; 12 bars total
features:
Features

Crunchy texture with whole-grain oats & crisp rice: Made with real whole-grain oats and crisp rice for a hearty crunch.

Warm cinnamon flavor: Lightly sweet and spiced with natural cinnamon for a comforting, familiar taste.

22g of whole grain per serving: Supports daily whole grain intake for a healthier snack option.

Clean-label recipe: Contains no artificial flavors, no colors from artificial sources, and no high-fructose corn syrup.

Individually wrapped twin-bar packs: Each pouch contains two crunchy bars—perfect for sharing or saving one for later.

Benefits

Easy, on-the-go snack: Ideal for busy mornings, road trips, lunchboxes, or a quick break at work

Sustained energy: Whole grains help provide lasting energy and satisfy hunger between meals.

Wholesome and simple: Appeals to those looking for recognizable, straightforward ingredients

Family-friendly: The mild cinnamon flavor and satisfying crunch make it a hit with both kids and adults.

Trusted quality: Made by Nature Valley—known for consistency in taste and texture.
ingredients: Whole Grain Oats, Sugar, Canola and/or Sunflower Oil, Rice Flour, Brown Sugar Syrup, Salt, Cinnamon, Baking Soda, Soy Lecithin.
